mem.short: This club's archive does not yet hold enough pairs for a wall.
mem.ready.title: {n} pairs. One look.
mem.ready.rule1: Every card lights up for three seconds. Photograph the wall in your head.
mem.ready.rule2: Then turn two at a time. A pair is two faces of one fact from the club's archive.
mem.ready.rule3: Three pairs in a row arms one echo: the next card you turn makes its partner blink.
mem.ready.shelf: {n} memories on your shelf so far.
mem.flash.title: Photograph it.
mem.flash.sub: Every card is face up. Remember where things are.
mem.hint.find: Turn two cards. Find two faces of the same memory.
mem.hint.miss: Not a pair. Remember where they were.
mem.hint.hot: On a streak. The wall is heating up.
mem.hint.echo: Something stirs: one card is blinking.
mem.peek.title: One more look at the whole wall, once per run
mem.shelf.title: Souvenir shelf
mem.shelf.empty: Find a pair and it is kept here.
mem.shelf.kept: {n} memories kept on this device, across every run.
mem.shelf.blocked: This device would not keep the shelf. This run still counts.
mem.announce.flash: All cards are face up for {s} seconds.
mem.announce.play: Cards face down. Find the pairs.
